eas_text: A civil authority has issued A SHELTER IN PLACE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Tuscarawas, OH; at 8:42 AM on AUG 20, 2026 Effective until 4:42 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Tuscarawas Alert. Attention Scenic View Rd SW area. Shelter in place due to a natural gas leak. Emergency crews are onscene. Please avoid the area, stay in doors. No open flames, including smoking. Effective until further notice.
